entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, talk about wild...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That was no aikido—that was some[n]hardcore ass whoopin'!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I am SO not pissing her off... I feel like[n]she'll rip off my arm.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She does exude that aura...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Oh, stop it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is the most exhausted I've ever[n]gotten these past few years...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... it felt pretty great.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I never thought I'd become part of the[n]Phantom Thieves I was after.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis might faint if she found out.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You mentioned her earlier.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She's a prosecutor for the district—and[n]she's investigating the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, ain't that bad!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: No need to worry. A normal investigation[n]would never lead them to a world like that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Then again, it must've been fate for this[n]to happen...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't be like my sister.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I had a feeling that there'd come a time[n]when we wouldn't see eye to eye[n]anymore.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm thankful to have a sister who works[n]so hard, but... there are times I feel sorry[n]for her too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And after hearing my Persona's voice,[n]I clearly understand how I feel now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It appears you're not as reserved[n]as you make yourself seem.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was just doing whatever the adults[n]told me to.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Won't she be perfect as our advisor?[n]She's fearless and has a sharp mind.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sounds good to me! We've needed[n]someone like that for a while now!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd be honored if I can help out.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We had way too much testosterone[n]anyway, so I feel much better hav—

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...It's from Kaneshiro. He's reminding us[n]of our debt.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So the Kaneshiro over here doesn't know[n]what happened inside the Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's right, but his Palace will be affected[n]if the real Kaneshiro's cognition changes.[n]We can't be lax.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It seems it'd be best to avoid unnecessary[n]contact with him until then.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Three weeks left, huh...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's that security system too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But if we pull this off, it'll definitely[n]be great!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We'll crush him like a fly. I'll make him[n]regret making me angry...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Anyways, let's begin our operation[n]tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: First, we need to secure a route to[n]the Treasure like always.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys are finally starting to get[n]used to this.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll be waiting for the call to meet up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Plus, I can understand what the cat's[n]saying now, too.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I'm not a cat, you know.
